near_term_sprints.name: WAREHOUSE_SQUARE9_REFERENCE_MATRIX_VALIDATION
near_term_sprints.objective: Locate and validate representative historical cases for JBS inbound R-number, JBS outbound shipment-number, Strategic inbound BOL-number, and Strategic outbound B/L-number workflows, including deterministic extraction/resolution and actual routing outcomes.
near_term_sprints.cutover_relevance: The Square9 work instructions prove materially different Warehouse reference-key conventions beyond W118093; broad Warehouse parity cannot be claimed until these patterns are validated or proven obsolete/out of scope.

near_term_sprints.name: GUI_TRUTH_FUNCTION_REPORTING_AUDIT
near_term_sprints.objective: Inventory and reconcile the active GPI Hub GUI, every operator action, and all operational reporting against authoritative backend truth; remove or hide inaccurate, contradictory, duplicative, or unnecessary AP/Warehouse surfaces before cutover.
near_term_sprints.cutover_relevance: Misleading operator state is a parity risk and becomes a parity blocker when it can cause an incorrect action or conceal failed delivery.

notes: REV5 proved exact image IDs, preserved the completed Mongo restore, started all three target services, and confirmed BC/SharePoint safety flags. It also exposed that the isolated target backend started AP mailbox polling and background schedulers. The target backend/frontend were manually quiesced successfully; Mongo remains running. REV6 is now the authoritative read-only discovery phase to identify the exact runtime controls needed to suppress mailbox polling and schedulers before any target backend restart. Source, traffic, and Production remain untouched.
